record.bible_text: Knowest<WH03045><WTH8804> thou the time<WH06256> when the wild goats<WH03277> of the rock<WH05553> bring forth<WH03205><WTH8800>? <FI>or<Fi> canst thou mark<WH08104><WTH8799> when the hinds<WH0355> do calve<WH02342><WTH8790>?
Canst thou number<WH05608><WTH8799> the months<WH03391> <FI>that<Fi> they fulfil<WH04390><WTH8762>? or knowest<WH03045><WTH8804> thou the time<WH06256> when they bring forth<WH03205><WTH8800>?
They bow<WH03766><WTH8799> themselves, they bring forth<WH06398><WTH8762> their young ones<WH03206>, they cast out<WH07971><WTH8762> their sorrows<WH02256>.
Their young ones<WH01121> are in good liking<WH02492><WTH8799>, they grow up<WH07235><WTH8799> with corn<WH01250>; they go forth<WH03318><WTH8804>, and return<WH07725><WTH8804> not unto them.
Who hath sent out<WH07971><WTH8765> the wild ass<WH06501> free<WH02670>? or who hath loosed<WH06605><WTH8765> the bands<WH04147> of the wild ass<WH06171>?
Whose house<WH01004> I have made<WH07760><WTH8804> the wilderness<WH06160>, and the barren<WH04420> land his dwellings<WH04908>. <RF>barren...: Heb. salt places<Rf>

He scorneth<WH07832><WTH8799> the multitude<WH01995> of the city<WH07151>, neither regardeth<WH08085><WTH8799> he the crying<WH08663> of the driver<WH05065><WTH8802>. <RF>of the driver: Heb. of the exactor<Rf>
The range<WH03491> of the mountains<WH02022> <FI>is<Fi> his pasture<WH04829>, and he searcheth<WH01875><WTH8799> after<WH0310> every green thing<WH03387>.
Will the unicorn<WH07214> be willing<WH014><WTH8799> to serve<WH05647><WTH8800> thee, or abide<WH03885><WTH8799> by thy crib<WH018>?
Canst thou bind<WH07194><WTH8799> the unicorn<WH07214> with his band<WH05688> in the furrow<WH08525>? or will he harrow<WH07702><WTH8762> the valleys<WH06010> after<WH0310> thee?
Wilt thou trust<WH0982><WTH8799> him, because his strength<WH03581> <FI>is<Fi> great<WH07227>? or wilt thou leave<WH05800><WTH8799> thy labour<WH03018> to him?
Wilt thou believe<WH0539><WTH8686> him, that he will bring home<WH07725><WTH8686><WTH8675><WH07725><WTH8799> thy seed<WH02233>, and gather<WH0622><WTH8799> <FI>it into<Fi> thy barn<WH01637>?<CM>

<FI> Gavest thou<Fi> the goodly<WH07443> wings<WH03671> unto the peacocks<WH05965><WTH8738>? or wings<WH084> and feathers<WH02624> unto the ostrich<WH05133>? <RF>wings and...: or, the feathers of the stork and ostrich<Rf>
Which leaveth<WH05800><WTH8799> her eggs<WH01000> in the earth<WH0776>, and warmeth<WH02552><WTH8762> them in dust<WH06083>,
And forgetteth<WH07911><WTH8799> that the foot<WH07272> may crush<WH02115><WTH8799> them, or that the wild<WH07704> beast<WH02416> may break<WH01758><WTH8799> them.
She is hardened<WH07188><WTH8689> against her young ones<WH01121>, as though <FI>they were<Fi> not<WH03808> hers: her labour<WH03018> is in vain<WH07385> without fear<WH06343>;
Because God<WH0433> hath deprived<WH05382><WTH8689> her of wisdom<WH02451>, neither hath he imparted<WH02505><WTH8804> to her understanding<WH0998>.
What time<WH06256> she lifteth up<WH04754><WTH8686> herself on high<WH04791>, she scorneth<WH07832><WTH8799> the horse<WH05483> and his rider<WH07392><WTH8802>.<CM>
Hast thou given<WH05414><WTH8799> the horse<WH05483> strength<WH01369>? hast thou clothed<WH03847><WTH8686> his neck<WH06677> with thunder<WH07483>?
Canst thou make him afraid<WH07493><WTH8686> as a grasshopper<WH0697>? the glory<WH01935> of his nostrils<WH05170> <FI>is<Fi> terrible<WH0367>. <RF>terrible: Heb. terror<Rf>

He paweth<WH02658><WTH8799> in the valley<WH06010>, and rejoiceth<WH07797><WTH8799> in <FI>his<Fi> strength<WH03581>: he goeth on<WH03318><WTH8799> to meet<WH07125><WTH8800> the armed men<WH05402>. <RF>He paweth: or, His feet dig<Rf> <RF>the armed...: Heb. the armour<Rf>
He mocketh<WH07832><WTH8799> at fear<WH06343>, and is not affrighted<WH02865><WTH8735>; neither turneth he back<WH07725><WTH8799> from<WH06440> the sword<WH02719>.
The quiver<WH0827> rattleth<WH07439><WTH8799> against him, the glittering<WH03851> spear<WH02595> and the shield<WH03591>.
He swalloweth<WH01572><WTH8762> the ground<WH0776> with fierceness<WH07494> and rage<WH07267>: neither believeth<WH0539><WTH8686> he that <FI>it is<Fi> the sound<WH06963> of the trumpet<WH07782>.

He saith<WH0559><WTH8799> among<WH01767> the trumpets<WH07782>, Ha<WH01889>, ha<WH01889>; and he smelleth<WH07306><WTH8686> the battle<WH04421> afar off<WH07350>, the thunder<WH07482> of the captains<WH08269>, and the shouting<WH08643>.<CM>
Doth the hawk<WH05322> fly<WH082><WTH8686> by thy wisdom<WH0998>, <FI>and<Fi> stretch<WH06566><WTH8799> her wings<WH03671> toward the south<WH08486>?
Doth the eagle<WH05404> mount up<WH01361><WTH8686> at thy command<WH06310>, and make<WH07311><WH00> her nest<WH07064> on high<WH07311><WTH8686>? <RF>at...: Heb. by thy mouth<Rf>
She dwelleth<WH07931><WTH8799> and abideth<WH03885><WTH8698> on the rock<WH05553>, upon the crag<WH08127> of the rock<WH05553>, and the strong place<WH04686>.
From thence she seeketh<WH02658><WTH8804> the prey<WH0400>, <FI>and<Fi> her eyes<WH05869> behold<WH05027><WTH8686> afar off<WH07350>.
Her young ones<WH0667> also suck up<WH05966><WTH8762> blood<WH01818>: and where the slain<WH02491> <FI>are<Fi> , there <FI>is<Fi> she<WH01931>.<CM>
